active_deliverable: Reacquire full-record final-correction LER curves using the validated optimized runner.
question: For the accepted Lab 006 artifact decoder with its complete interior record (m,R), what are the final-correction LER curves from p=0 to p=0.5 on honeycomb and square lattices for U(1), SU(2), and SU(3)?

frozen_decoder.algorithm: sum_product BP followed by posterior-LLR PyMatching
frozen_decoder.rough_boundary: neither m nor R is measured; both are marginalized

runner_optimization.implementation: Numba-pretabulated fusion-record generation; PyMatching decode_batch for fixed-weight no-herald control only.
runner_optimization.equivalence: Fixed-seed m and all group label codes, fixed-weight corrections, and full LER output rows agree exactly on square/honeycomb L=5,9 fixtures.
runner_optimization.constraint: Full-record posterior weights differ by shot, so its weighted PyMatching instance remains per shot; PyMatching exposes no supported in-place bulk edge-weight update.

primary_metric: Final-correction decoder failure: the correction must clear the detector syndrome and error XOR correction must have trivial logical parity. BP nonconvergence is diagnostic only and never gates LER.
invalidated_pre_correction_results: All A7/A8 rows acquired before this scoring correction counted BP nonconvergence as failure and are prohibited from LER or threshold inference; aggregate counts cannot be repaired without replaying shots because overlap with true logical failures was not stored.
presentation: six separate figures, one per lattice/group. Each figure shows only the four code distances, Wilson 95% intervals, and a separate companion plot for BP nonconvergence.
acceptance: Every figure identifies its lattice, group, full (m,R) record, directed channel, and number of independent samples.
The p=0 point is the exact zero-error endpoint, not a sampled or extrapolated value.
No m-only, no-herald, boundary-record, or cross-group curve appears in a primary LER panel.
The LER and companion convergence figure derive from the same checkpointed raw counts.
claim_boundary: Finite-size curves only; no threshold estimate until the high-statistics size ordering and convergence diagnostics are jointly analyzed.
